title: Code and results for: Evaluating Temporal Feature Engineering and Data-Quality Treatments for LightGBM-Based Rainfall Occurrence Classification
description: Reproducibility materials for the JESSI article. Includes the preprocessing implementation (target-leakage exclusion, chronological lag-feature generation on exact calendar days, training-based imputation, SMOTENC, IQR and Z-score capping, Isolation Forest filtering), the exact chronological and five stratified partitions stored as Location-Date keys, the A1-A8 scenario configurations and LightGBM hyperparameters, test-set predictions of every scenario, and the code and outputs of the paired weekly block bootstrap, exploratory Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction, validation-only sensitivity analysis, and rainfall-intensity error analysis. The WeatherAUS dataset is not redistributed.
